text:
Brandt-Ueno Civil has won the contract to rebuild the Okarra Bridge, the Okarra Regional Authority announced on 14 March 2025.

The contract is valued at 218 million credits, with completion scheduled within 36 months. The award is set out in the authority's Notice of Award, Tender Reference OKB-2024-07, which was published after the final board session.

Delphine Aurelio-Voss, Director of Transport Infrastructure for the Okarra Regional Authority, confirmed the selection.

"Brandt-Ueno Civil was chosen following the board's final session, and the terms of the award are set out in full in the published notice," Aurelio-Voss said.

The notice names Brandt-Ueno Civil as the successful bidder for the rebuilding work. The 36-month completion period is written into the award.

The Okarra Bridge project is now expected to move from tender into delivery under the terms published by the authority.
